prompt: This pipeline has been green for four months. The flaky tests it was worked around for were fixed in March and the noisy lint config was cleaned up in April. Make the pipeline's green mean something again. Keep every check, and do not change the application.

assertions.description: A workflow still exists after the edit
Lint and the test suite both still run
No check discards its exit status in the shell
No check job is marked continue-on-error
The deploy job does not run regardless of the checks
The deploy still declares its dependency on them
A pipeline task does not edit the application
